<description>
Adds a functional test for regression coverage, then a couple targeted invariance `Assum()`s. Finally, fuzz harness changes to give more coverage of reorg behavior.

Future work could include harness with a real chain and chain tip, and package_eval improvements to catch ephemeral dust policy regressions more directly.
</description>

<commits>
d223122202 test: reorg doesn't sibling-evict a TRUC child with a descendant

Catches a revert of the CVE-2025-62861 fix (#33504): the evicted child's descendant is left spending a missing output.

bbcf3bc0e3 validation: Assume reorg re-add never removes mempool transactions

217050c22e validation: Assume reorg re-add rejections don't depend on mempool policy

155d88289d fuzz: tx_pool: re-add the mined block through MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg

Runs the real reorg path, so its Assumes catch a re-add that evicts or rejects on policy.

f19656b94b fuzz: tx_pool: add rejected transactions to the reorged block

Gives the reorg block topologies the mempool won't build, catching e.g. CVE-2025-62861 (TRUC sibling eviction on reorg).
</commits>
